title: From Reachability to Learnability: Geometric Design Principles for Quantum Neural Networks
summary: Classical deep networks are effective because depth enables adaptive geometric deformation of data representations. In quantum neural networks (QNNs), however, depth or state reachability alone does not guarantee this feature-learning capability. We study this question in the pure-state setting by viewing encoded data as an embedded manifold in $\mathbb{C}P^{2^n-1}$ and analysing infinitesimal unitary actions through Lie-algebra directions.
